description: This file contains the implementation of the ProjectRepository interface, providing methods to find, save, and remove Project entities using ProjectDao. It is a repository class in the persistence layer, annotated with Spring's @Repository.

classes.name: ProjectRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for ProjectRepository, handling project-related database operations.

methods.name: findProject
methods.description: Retrieves a Project entity by its ID using the ProjectDao.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Saves a Project entity to the database via the ProjectDao.

methods.name: removeProject
methods.description: Removes a Project entity by its ID using the ProjectDao.
